headline: Bias, prejudice, discrimination · 05:04

items.title: 05:04 · Whether measured through response latencies or field
items.detail: Whether measured through response latencies or field audits, bias names a cognitive weighting or inclination inside an individual's evaluative apparatus.

items.title: 05:12 · The second construct is prejudice Gordon Allport
05:21 · Allport defines ethnic prejudice as an antipathy
items.detail: Allport defines ethnic prejudice as an antipathy grounded in a faulty and inflexible generalization, which may be felt internally or expressed outwardly.

items.title: 05:30 · Allport specifies that this antipathy may be
items.detail: Allport specifies that this antipathy may be directed toward a group as a whole, or toward an individual specifically because that individual is a member of that group.

items.title: 05:41 · Where bias captures an evaluative tilt or
items.detail: Where bias captures an evaluative tilt or associative trace, prejudice names an affective posture coupled to a rigid, overgeneralized belief that resists counter-evidence.
